name: Sunrise Group Company Limited
summary: Sunrise Group Company Limited, along with its associated entities, specializes in the entire lifecycle of food and beverage packaging, from design and printing to manufacturing, distribution, and international sales. Their product portfolio includes a variety of metal packaging solutions, such as two-piece and three-piece cans, aluminum bottles, bottom covers, and screw caps. Beyond manufacturing, Sunrise Group offers a comprehensive suite of services. These encompass beverage filling, creative packaging design, logistical support, and research and development for beverage formulations. Additionally, the company provides advanced printing capabilities, including color and digital printing, alongside photoelectric lighting solutions and other value-added services. Further diversifying its offerings, Sunrise Group delivers smart marketing and IP marketing strategies, in-depth package design expertise, robust anti-counterfeiting and anti-channeling traceability systems, and video production capabilities. Founded in 1992 and headquartered in Fuzhou, China, the company operated as Shengxing Group Co.,Ltd until December 2019, when it officially rebranded to Sunrise Group Company Limited. It functions as a subsidiary under Shengxing Holdings Co., Ltd.
